reason: Most of what I get is barter from small cafes and salons, maybe one paid offer in a month, so I'd try the free version for the scam check but I don't see why I'd pay for Pro yet. It also doesn't bring me any new brands, it only manages the ones I already find through my WhatsApp groups.
objection: This doesn't get me collabs, it just helps with offers I already have. For a Kannada creator my problem is that brands don't come to me at all. And I'm not sure I want an app sending payment reminders from my account to the local businesses I'm trying to build relationships with.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually sent me paid offers from Bengaluru businesses looking for Kannada creators, I'd pay the ₹199 without thinking.
